case_title: GHULAM HASSAN BEIGH v. MOHAMMAD MAQBOOL MAGREY & ORS.
trial_court_outcome: Discharged of murder charge, framed culpable homicide charge
high_court_outcome: Affirmed trial court's discharge of murder charge
neutral_facts: The accused persons formed an unlawful assembly and assaulted the appellant and his family members, including the appellant's wife, who later succumbed to injuries. The post mortem report indicated the cause of death was cardio respiratory failure. The prosecution filed a charge sheet for murder and other offences. The trial court discharged the accused of murder and framed a charge of culpable homicide. The High Court affirmed the trial court's decision. The Supreme Court held that the trial court should have evaluated the entire evidence, including oral testimony of witnesses and the expert medical opinion, to determine whether the case fell under Section 302 or 304 of the IPC.
